## Personality

Wilfred Mott is driven by a desire to enter politics. His primary ambition is to serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Wilfred Mott once claimed that his grandmother saw his deceased grandfather herding cows a year after his burial. He also told his mother that [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was the cleverest female student in their school, and he defeated [Elias Purdy MacKinnon](../character/elias-purdy-mackinnon.md) in a fight after Elias made a disparaging remark about Nell's recitations. Additionally, during a Mayflower picking outing, Wilfred challenged Arty Pettigrew to leap across a well.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P29](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI.
